items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: when we took a whole tour. It was Sonny Rollins and his quartet, or no it was the trio, and it was Dave Brubeck with his group, Maynard Ferguson’s band.

ctx.x: I think the only time that we had any problems like that was when we took a whole tour. It was Sonny Rollins and his quartet, or no it was the trio, and it was Dave Brubeck with his group, Maynard Ferguson’s band. And then there was another, might have been The Four Freshmen or somebody like that. And we played really all through the south you know, because it was such a big thing that they would command everywhere for it. And we had some problems about finding places to eat and things like that once in a while.…
In what parts of the country?
